Subject: Onboarding: Redwood Inference - DPA, SOC2, PO details

Hi Karthik / Lauren,

Thanks for the quick intro earlier. We're excited to get PineTech set up as a vendor for Redwood. Procurement at our end needs a few items to complete the activation and PO routing: 

- Your current DPA (we'll need to circulate internally; please include the Redwood signature block and any standard redlines you won't accept).
- Access to your SOC 2 report or a link to a secure viewer. If the report is restricted, can we get a time-limited access link or a secure copy?
- A current list of sub-processors (CSV preferred) so our security team can reconcile with our vendor map.
- PO setup fields: legal entity name, remit-to address, tax id / VAT, desired invoice email, and any required purchase order template.

Can you also confirm whether Redwood requires invoices to reference a specific SOW or deal id? We'll also attach our vendor W-9 and a short intake form on our side once we have the DPA.

Thanks — happy to hop on a short call if that's easier.

Regards,

Alex —

Appreciate the clear checklist. High-level next steps from our side: 

1) DPA: Attaching our current standard DPA (Redwood_DPA_v1.2.pdf). We typically accept a few narrow redlines (data retention, breach notification timeline). If you have material redlines, send them as comments in a tracked copy. For speed, many vendors accept our DPA as-is; if you need any language swapped for local law, flag it and we'll loop legal.

2) SOC 2: Our Q4-2026 SOC 2 report is available via a secure viewer. I'll request a time-limited link from security and share it in a follow-up thread (link below once it's provisioned). Note: access is gated; we require a short NDA for third-party review in some accounts — I'll call that out if it applies.

3) Subprocessors: Please send the CSV file, ideally columns: name, purpose, region, data types processed, last attestation date. If easier, attach your existing spreadsheet.

4) PO fields: We require these fields to create a vendor record: legal entity (as on tax docs), remit-to address, tax ID (TIN/VAT), primary billing contact email, EIN/W9 for US entities. Invoices should reference the Redwood deal id if available (for this engagement, reference DEAL-4832).

5) Timeline & attachments: If you can provide the signed DPA + subprocessor CSV + W-9, procurement can start PO creation immediately. Our procurement SLA is 5-7 business days for standard vendors once we have complete paperwork.

I've CC'd Lauren (Finance ops) to own PO routing and Jordan (Customer Success) so they have onboarding visibility.

Attachments referenced: Redwood_DPA_v1.2.pdf (attached).

I'll follow up with the SOC 2 link separately (security is provisioning access now).

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
